description: Trainline libère les gares européennes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trainline. Database of European railway stations We are at the center of European rail and bus operators. It goes without saying that these carriers all have their own offers, languages and data. To successfully combine all these offers, we had to make a harmonisation effort. Coverage: Trainline. The portal shows the English title as "Trainline frees European stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Trainline. Its keywords include data, ferroviaire, tgv, ter, train, donnees. The listing shows 2 download or service links in MARKDOWN, CSV. The listing shows 2018-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
